notes: Mid-market product analytics vendor. Evaluating Redwood as replacement for current embeddings+rerank stack. Primary ask: EU-first deployment with strict data residency for stored vectors and logs. Wants hosted API for quick POC, then move to Dedicated if latency/cost justify. CTO quote: "We need EU data to never leave the EU for customer data at rest — transient routing ok if encrypted, but logs and KV must stay in EU." Latency target: p95 < 250ms for single-turn chat/assist, throughput ~150 reqs/sec initially (burst to 500). Cost sensitivity: moderate — will trade some cost for guaranteed residency and lower tail latency. Interested in quantization recommendations and prefix-caching to reduce unit cost. POC acceptance criteria: p95 latency in EU Dedicated <= 220ms, embedding recall delta <2% vs baseline, predictable per-token billing within 15% of quoted. Key internal stakeholders: CTO Mira Sokolov, Head of Product Jonas Alvarez, Infra Lead Petra Novak. Planning a 2-week dedicated POC (EU region) followed by procurement if ok.
